edges.subject: neuronal ceroid lipofuscinoses
edges.quote: Neuronal ceroid lipofuscinoses (NCLs) are a group of rare neurodegenerative storage disorders associated with devastating visual prognosis

edges.subject: neuronal ceroid lipofuscinoses
edges.quote: NCLs are categorized into different types depending upon the underlying cause i.e., soluble lysosomal enzyme deficiencies or non-enzymatic deficiencies

edges.subject: neuronal ceroid lipofuscinoses
edges.quote: The pathophysiological mechanisms causing NCLs occur due to enzymatic or transmembrane defects in various sub-cellular organelles including lysosomes, endoplasmic reticulum, and cytoplasmic vesicles
